title: Getting settled
body: Your private onboarding controls help you settle into Chairs at your own pace.
rules: Read the server rules before choosing Acknowledge Rules. Acknowledgement records your acceptance and restores only access permitted by the server settings and any active restrictions.
roles: Choose optional cosmetic roles from the server’s configured categories. Open /roles to see available choices and your current selections. If the panel is unavailable, the server team still needs to finish setup; no role has been changed.

steps: Open the command when you are ready to use its real controls.
Read the available rules or role categories before making a selection.
For roles, respect each category’s single or multiple selection limit; deselect choices to remove them.
Reopen /roles to check your saved choices. Unavailable or unmanageable roles are rejected safely.
Practice only reviews these instructions. It does not acknowledge rules, grant access, or change your roles.
